description: Regression tests after Phase 3.6 bug fixes: ouroboros prevhash validation, rustoshi getblockhash height index

fixes_tested.ouroboros: df3543f - fix: validate block prevhash against chain tip before connecting
fixes_tested.rustoshi: e3d8b75 - fix: populate height-to-hash index during submitblock

consensus_tests.description: Submitted 200 blocks from Core to both nodes, verified block hashes match

rustoshi.verdict: PASS - height index now populated correctly during submitblock

bad_merkle_root.description: Block with first 3 bytes of merkle root set to 0xff

rustoshi.verdict: PASS (rejected for PoW since merkle change invalidates hash)

bad_prevhash.description: Block with first 3 bytes of prevhash set to 0xff

ouroboros.result: Block prev_hash ... does not match chain tip ...

out_of_order_block.description: Submit block 203 before block 202 has been received

ouroboros.result: Block prev_hash ... does not match chain tip ...
ouroboros.verdict: PASS - prevhash validation catches out-of-order blocks

ouroboros_pow_validation.description: ouroboros accepts blocks with invalid proof-of-work. A block with nonce flipped to 0xffffffff was accepted and connected to the chain. This allows trivially forged blocks to be accepted.
ouroboros_pow_validation.reproduction: Submit any block with an invalid nonce via submitblock RPC - it will be accepted and connected.

overall_summary.ouroboros_prevhash_fix: VERIFIED - prevhash validation working correctly for both corrupt prevhash and out-of-order blocks
overall_summary.rustoshi_height_index_fix: VERIFIED - getblockhash returns correct hashes for all heights after submitblock
overall_summary.ouroboros_pow_bug: NEW ISSUE - blocks with invalid PoW are accepted (CRITICAL)
overall_summary.consensus_200_blocks: PASS for both nodes (before invalid block tests)
